name: Queen Mary University of London
description: Queen Mary University of London is a world-leading research-intensive university with over 25,000 students representing more than 160 nationalities. A member of the prestigious Russell Group, it specializes in the humanities and social sciences, medicine and dentistry, and science and engineering, with inspirational teaching directly informed by research. In the most recent exercise that rated research in the UK, Queen Mary was ranked 5th in the country for the proportion of research outputs that were world-leading or internationally excellent. Queen Mary’s history dates back to 1785, with the foundation of the London Hospital Medical College and located in East London. Timestamps Updated
